name: What's the difference between a bidet toilet seat and a full bidet toilet, and which should I choose?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a bidet toilet seat and a full bidet toilet, and which should I choose?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bidet toilet seat is an attachment that replaces your existing toilet seat, offering bidet functions like water spray and drying. A full bidet toilet is a single, integrated unit with the bidet features built directly into the toilet bowl. Choosing between them often comes down to budget, aesthetic preference, and the extent of desired features. Bidet seats are generally more affordable and easier to install, while full bidet toilets offer a sleeker look and potentially more advanced features. Consider your bathroom's design and your feature priorities when making your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bidet seats attach to existing toilets, while full bidet toilets are integrated units. Choose based on budget, aesthetics, and desired features.
